behaviorCovered: Live completed and failed steps retain numeric zero, accounting status, reason and catalog digest; zero tokens do not suppress cost metadata.
Initial hydration restores latest settled assistant accounting with or without transcript replay and computes context usage from the recorded model.
Resize and reconnect restore the latest root step, ignore active assistant and compaction records, and prevent already-projected older settlements or child accounting from replacing the root price.
A failed step without accounting clears the previous price both on the live event and on the authoritative idle read.
Real production footer renders reported zero, estimate, unknown zero, partial subtotal, legacy positive/zero and missing accounting in the terminal fixture.
At 100 columns the fixture displays all cost variants; after resize to 40 columns and hiding routine details, the real menu still exposes scope and marker explanations through Show status.
Existing responsive tests retain interrupt and exit behavior, identity/context priority, and reported cost layouts in mono and colored rendering.
limits: The expanded suite retains seven baseline failures in menu height and prompt shortcuts; the entire repository test suite was not run.

Terminal component rendering uses the production OpenTUI components with fixture data. Transport tests use the generated SDK with stubbed methods. No live TUI service, HTTP/SSE server or provider invocation was validated in this batch.
Mini displays last settled root step accounting, not aggregate session-family spending or reconciled invoices. Detailed provider media/cache meters and validated V2 default cutover remain pending.
Existing responsive priority may hide the menu hint behind higher-priority identity, context or a longer unavailable-cost label; its configured shortcut and Show status remain available.
No paid inference, service restart, remote CI, push or publication.
